user.title: AIS Tanker Tracker
user.description: Tracks tanker vessels (AIS ship type 80-89) from the local AIS-catcher MQTT stream, aisstream.io and AISHub.

data_description.enable_mqtt: Subscribe to the JSON messages published by the AIS-catcher add-on (MSGFORMAT JSON_FULL).
data_description.mqtt_topic: Topic used by AIS-catcher, wildcards allowed (for example ais/# or ais/data).
data_description.aisstream_api_key: Free real time AIS feed (sign in at aisstream.io). Leave empty to disable.
data_description.aishub_zones: Format name:latmin,latmax,lonmin,lonmax. Separate multiple zones with ; or new lines. Empty: global AISHub request and a 3 degree box around home for aisstream.io.
data_description.aishub_scan_interval: Seconds between two AISHub requests (minimum 65, AISHub allows 1 request per minute).
data_description.stale_timeout_minutes: Vessels without updates for this time are removed.
data_description.max_tracked_vessels: Nearest tankers that get a device_tracker entity (0 disables trackers).
data_description.enable_demo_vessels: Adds 3 moving test tankers in the Andaman Sea / Strait of Malacca.

error.invalid_zones: Invalid zone definition. Use name:latmin,latmax,lonmin,lonmax with latmin < latmax and lonmin < lonmax.
error.scan_interval_too_low: The AISHub interval must be at least 65 seconds.
error.no_source: Enable at least one source: MQTT, aisstream.io key, AISHub key or demo vessels.

abort.already_configured: AIS Tanker Tracker is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of AIS Tanker Tracker is allowed.
